note: API ids move fast and this file was written 2026-08-24. Nothing here is trusted until release/tools/verify_model_ids.py resolves each entry against the live provider API and writes the resolved id back. An entry that cannot be resolved is dropped from the panel WITH a recorded access-failure, never silently omitted.

tiers.1_frontier_api: Current proprietary frontier, Aug 2026. Published peer-comparison metadata remain in the machine-readable configuration but are intentionally omitted from the live tracker tables.
tiers.2_reasoning: Explicit reasoning variants. MMSI-Bench found reasoning accuracy lags multiple-choice by 8-10 points, and mental rotation is exactly where chain-of-thought should help, so a paper claiming models cannot do this without letting one think will not survive review.
tiers.3_open_large: Open-weight at scale, run locally. Free apart from disk and time.
tiers.4_open_small: Open-weight small/mid, already cached locally. Cheap scaling-curve points.
tiers.5_spatial_specialist: Required category (plan section 10.1): at least one 2026 spatial-specialised model, or a documented access failure per model.

models.name: SpaceMind
models.note: CVPR 2026. Weights ARE public at MikeDuke/SpaceMind (17.8 GB); the GitHub README's 'weights TODO' is stale. internvl_chat architecture with an auto_map exposing AutoModel/AutoModelForCausalLM -- not AutoModelForImageTextToText, so the loader needs an internvl_chat branch.
models.access_failure: Weights ARE public (MikeDuke/SpaceMind, 17.8 GB, 4 safetensors shards). Not loadable as published: config.json declares auto_map -> configuration_internvl_chat.py, and that file is absent from the repo (18 files, no .py), so trust_remote_code loading fails with OSError. Running it requires the modeling code from github.com/RealMikeDuke/SpaceMind plus separate InternVL3-8B and VGGT checkpoints per its README. Verified 2026-08-25.

models.name: 3DThinker
models.note: CVPR 2026. Released checkpoint is the STAGE-1 model fine-tuned on MindCube over Qwen2.5-VL-3B, not the full pipeline: the paper's VGGT-grounded 3D mentaling is applied at inference and is not part of this checkpoint. Standard Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, so it loads with the existing path. Report it as the released artifact, not as full 3DThinker.
models.access_failure: Weights ARE public (jankin123/3DThinker-Mindcube, 18.9 GB). Loads as a standard Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, but 28 of 852 tensors -- the projector_model/fusion_model stack that implements the paper's 3D mentaling -- are UNEXPECTED to that architecture and are silently discarded. The processor also ships no chat template. Evaluating it via the standard path would measure the fine-tuned backbone with the paper's distinctive component removed, so it is not reported as 3DThinker. Verified 2026-08-25.

models.name: SenseNova-SI-1.2-InternVL3-8B
models.note: spatial specialist; paired backbone in this panel: InternVL3-8B
models.access_failure: Weights ARE public and cached (14.8 GiB), but the checkpoint ships its own InternVL-chat code written against transformers ~4.3x and will not load under the panel's transformers 5.5.0. Two distinct incompatibilities, verified 2026-08-25: modeling_intern_vit.py builds its drop-path schedule with torch.linspace(...).item() inside the meta-device init context (RuntimeError: Tensor.item() cannot be called on meta tensors), and once that is bypassed InternVLChatModel lacks all_tied_weights_keys, an attribute transformers 5 requires. This is a property of the whole internvl_chat line, not one checkpoint: SenseNova-SI 1.1/1.2/1.3/1.5-InternVL3-8B all declare model_type=internvl_chat with vendored code, and no -hf conversion is published. Not evaluated rather than evaluated through rewritten model code. Superseded in the panel by SenseNova-SI-1.3-Qwen3-VL-8B (newer, loads natively).

models.name: QVQ-72B-Preview
models.generation_note: Official QVQ Transformers quickstart allowance; required because the checkpoint emits visual reasoning before its final answer.
models.access_failure: Evaluation infeasible under the frozen, scientifically valid generation contract on the available hardware. Qwen/QVQ-72B-Preview loads successfully across four NVIDIA L40S GPUs, but the official 8,192-token allowance averaged about 7.6 minutes per item in a three-item fail-closed probe. The declared Task A/B/C panel scope (1,192/1,098/1,200 items) therefore projects to roughly 18 days of exclusive four-GPU time and cannot complete within the WACV evaluation window. A historical 48-token run was invalid because it truncated the model before its final answer. Verified 2026-08-26/27; four stopped, terminally parsed Task-B probe rows and logs are preserved under work/model_panel/invalid_runs/qvq_infeasible_20260827/.

models.name: EgoMind-7B
models.note: POST-FREEZE PANEL AMENDMENT 2026-08-26: CVPR 2026 geometry-free egocentric spatial-reasoning specialist, added prospectively before its outputs were inspected. Official checkpoint Hyggge/EgoMind-7B (8.29B stored parameters, BF16, Apache-2.0), fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct. This creates a capacity-matched specialist/backbone comparison and diversifies Tier 5 beyond SenseNova/Cosmos. Task A uses the full 5,838-item pool, matching every runnable Tier 5 specialist; Task B uses the complete canonical pool; Task C uses the common frozen 1,200-item subset.

models.name: Molmo2-8B
models.note: POST-FREEZE PANEL AMENDMENT 2026-08-26: official CVPR 2026 Molmo2 8B checkpoint, added prospectively before its outputs were inspected. Ai2 identifies 8B as the strongest overall Molmo2 size. It is an Apache-2.0, 8.66B-parameter, Qwen3-8B-based model with explicit multi-image training, adding an independent open-model lineage and a matched-scale comparison with Qwen3-VL-8B. Task A uses the full 5,838-item pool, matching every runnable Tier 4 open-small model; Task B uses the complete canonical pool; Task C uses the common frozen 1,200-item subset.
